asset: Owner-installed Windows fonts for the Door Text Unicode fallback chain
license: owner-local Windows font, not redistributable, private build
decision: Owner decision 2026-10-23 (docs/design/p12-p13-plan-20261023.md, item 2): use the installed Windows fonts for this private build; never publish them
acquisition: Read-only byte copies from C:/Windows/Fonts on the owner's Windows 11 PC; host files were not modified; each copy compared byte-identical (cmp) after copying
use: Loaded at run time from caller-supplied bytes by door-graphics-text FontSet::from_files or a FontProvider; never embedded with include_bytes!

faces: 0 Segoe UI Emoji (COLR/CPAL v0 and v1 colour glyphs)
1 Yu Gothic UI (selected; the Regular UI face ships in this collection, not YuGothR.ttc)

files.note: Added under 'others as needed' for the Hindi/Devanagari corpus; Segoe UI has no Indic coverage

also_used: assets/fonts/segoe-ui/segoeui.ttf and seguisb.ttf (Ui: Arabic, Hebrew, Armenian, Georgian)
not_copied: Bold CJK collections (msyhbd.ttc, msjhbd.ttc, YuGothB.ttc, malgunbd.ttf; about 59 MB) are omitted; weights >= 600 use synthetic horizontal emboldening for static faces lighter than 550
scope: Not Microsoft DirectWrite/ClearType; shaping, fallback and rasterization are original Door Text code over HarfRust/Skrifa. No distribution right is inferred.
